name: Careful Spell
description: Spend 1 sorcery point to protect up to CHA-mod creatures from one of your spells. They automatically succeed on its saving throw and take no damage if they would normally take half on a success.

name: Distant Spell
description: Spend 1 sorcery point to double the range of a spell with a range of 5 feet or greater, or to make a touch spell's range 30 feet.

name: Empowered Spell
description: Spend 1 sorcery point to reroll up to CHA-mod damage dice on a spell (minimum 1). You can use Empowered Spell even if you've already used another Metamagic on the same spell.

name: Extended Spell
description: Spend 1 sorcery point to double the duration of a spell, up to a maximum of 24 hours. Affects spells with a duration of 1 minute or longer.

name: Heightened Spell
description: Spend 3 sorcery points when you cast a spell that forces a creature to make a saving throw to give one target disadvantage on its first save against the spell.

name: Quickened Spell
description: Spend 2 sorcery points to cast a spell with a casting time of 1 action as a bonus action instead.

name: Subtle Spell
description: Spend 1 sorcery point to cast a spell without any somatic or verbal components.

name: Twinned Spell
description: Spend sorcery points equal to the spell's level (1 for a cantrip) to target a second creature within range with a spell that targets only one creature and doesn't have a range of self.
